title: Wall Street backbone DTCC brings $30 trillion securities closer to blockchain with major banks
reason: DTCC taking $30 trillion in securities toward tokenization with JPMorgan, Citi and Morgan Stanley signed up is a major infrastructure change with named sources.

sources.summary: DTCC's tokenization service went live on Canton Network and private chain Besu, with JPMorgan, Citi and Morgan Stanley among 20 firms signed up.

title: Google to preview crypto custody security system as AI threats grow
reason: Google launching MPC-based crypto custody in private preview with major financial institutions testing is a significant infrastructure development.

sources.summary: Google Multi-Party Compute is in private preview, with several major financial institutions testing the technology and parent company Alphabet using it to secure its own digital assets on Ethereum and Solana.
